dc_eval_cbrn.quote: GPT-4o does not advance biological threat creation capabilities sufficient to meet our medium risk threshold.
dc_eval_cbrn.note: Threshold determination plus 69% tacit knowledge score.

dc_eval_cyber.quote: Given 10 attempts at each task, the model completed 19% of high-school level, 0% of collegiate level and 1% of professional level CTF challenges.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: GPT-4o scored a 0% on the autonomous replication and adaptation (ARA) tasks across 100 trials

dc_eval_persuasion.quote: Persuasive capabilities of GPT-4o marginally cross into our medium risk threshold from low risk.

dc_eval_scheming.quote: Based on these findings, Apollo Research believes that it is unlikely that GPT-4o is capable of catastrophic scheming.
dc_eval_scheming.note: Scheming result reported in card (timing rule applies only to ext_test items).

framework_threshold.quote: Therefore, the overall risk score for GPT-4o is classified as medium.

ext_test_any.quote: OpenAI worked with more than 100 external red teamers
ext_test_any.note: Access March to late June 2024, overlapping pre-release checkpoints.

ext_test_named_org.note: METR and Apollo tested 'Following the text output only deployment of GPT-4o' (after release, excluded by timing rule). Gryphon Scientific co-designed questions, did not test; language collaborators built evals. Red teamers are individuals.

ext_test_government.note: No government testing; 'UK AISI's Theory of Mind' is a benchmark name; White House commitments are not testing.

ext_test_timing_stated.quote: 10 red teamers working on early model checkpoints still in development
ext_test_timing_stated.note: External red teaming on in-development checkpoints, i.e. before release.

safeguards_training.quote: We post-trained GPT-4o to refuse to comply with requests to identify someone based on a voice in an audio input

safeguards_runtime.quote: We run our existing moderation classifier over text transcriptions of audio prompts and generations, and block the output for certain high-severity categories.

safeguards_access.note: Limited alpha of Advanced Voice Mode has no stated safety reason; preset voices are an output restriction, not access control.

safeguards_weights.note: Self-exfiltration evaluated as capability only; no weight protection stated.
